overview: 5G Lab Monitor for AI-assisted modem protocol script development with workspace pipeline tracking and history view.
features: Workspace rows with 4-stage pipeline indicators (NLP Output, Encoder, 3GPP data Ingestion, Script Creation)
Results button on rows once 3GPP data Ingestion completes
History page replicating the workspace with Results access to past requests
Results page with pipeline visual and copyable request details
